# Market note — inventory automation for Metro Manila SMB manufacturers (fixture)

Written 2026-09-02. Every figure below carries a claims-ledger token.

Under the Ease of Paying Taxes Act every sale of ₱500 or more must be invoiced, and the invoice
replaced the official receipt for services from 27 April 2024 [C-1].

Professional-services firms averaged 68.9 % billable utilisation and a 35.9 % project margin in
the 2025 SPI benchmark of 403 firms [C-2].

Small-business bookkeeping in the Philippines runs roughly ₱3,000 to ₱15,000 per month according
to a vendor blog, which we grade low [C-3].

```
This fenced block has 99 % and $1,000,000 in it and is ignored by the gate.
```

The year 2026 and the 2025 benchmark edition are dates, not claims, and need no token.
